newsitem.title: USA: Delta jet hit by truck on tarmac, one hurt.
newsitem.headline: Delta jet hit by truck on tarmac, one hurt.

text.p: A man fell to the tarmac after a delivery truck ran into a Delta Air Lines Inc. jet as it was boarding passengers at New York's LaGuardia Airport, pushing it away from the gate and opening a gap to the pavement below.
The truck was delivering tires when it clipped the wing of the Delta jet, pushing it several feet away from the gate, Delta spokesman Bill Berry said.
One passenger, a man, fell about seven feet to the ground. He was taken to a hospital "as a precaution," Berry said. Additional details were not immediately available.
The plane, originally bound for Dallas, will be inspected for damage.
"We are accommodating other passengers on other flights," Berry said.
